```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo        = TRUE,          # show the code in HTML
  tidy        = TRUE,          # run formatR on the code
  tidy.opts   = list(
    comment     = FALSE,       # <-- STRIP "#" comments from displayed code
    blank       = FALSE,       # drop blank lines
    widthCutoff = 120          # keep long lines readable
  ),
  comment     = NA,            # hide the "##" prefix on output
  warning     = FALSE,
  message     = FALSE,
  eval        = TRUE,
  fig.align   = "center",
  fig.width   = 10,
  fig.height  = 6,
  dpi         = 120,
  dev         = "png",
  fig.show    = "asis",
  fig.keep    = "all",
  out.width   = "100%"
)
                      
```

```{r}
cat_colors <- c(
  "Foundations"     = "#38bdf8",
  "Statistics"      = "#a78bfa",
  "Supervised ML"   = "#fbbf24",
  "Unsupervised ML" = "#34d399",

# ============================================================
#  CUSTOM CSS
# ============================================================
custom_css <- "
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,700;9..144,900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

:root{
  --ink:#0b1220;
  --ink-2:#1e293b;
  --muted:#64748b;
  --line:rgba(148,163,184,.18);
  --surface:#ffffff;
  --bg:#f6f7fb;
  --brand:#4f46e5;
  --brand-2:#06b6d4;
  --gold:#f5b301;
  --nav-bg:#0b1220;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;}
body{
  font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 700px at -10% -20%, #e0e7ff 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 600px at 110% 0%, #cffafe 0%, transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fafc 0%, #eef2f7 100%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  min-height:100vh;
  margin:0;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.02em;}
code, pre, .mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

/* -------- Navbar -------- */
.navbar{
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,#0b1220 0%, #111a33 50%, #0b1220 100%) !important;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.15) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(2,6,23,.35);
  padding:.35rem 1rem;
}
.navbar .navbar-brand{
  color:#f8fafc !important;
  font-weight:700;
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
}
.brand-dot{
  width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:9px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #ff8a00);
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color:#0b1220; font-weight:900; font-size:.95rem;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(245,179,1,.45);
}
.navbar .nav-link{
  color:#cbd5e1 !important;
  font-weight:500; font-size:.92rem;
  padding:.5rem .95rem !important;
  border-radius:10px;
  transition: all .2s ease;
}
.navbar .nav-link:hover{ color:#fff !important; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.navbar .nav-link.active{
  color:#fff !important;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,.25), rgba(6,182,212,.25));
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(148,163,184,.25);
}
.nav-cta{
  color:#f8fafc !important; background: rgba(245,179,1,.15);
  border:1px solid rgba(245,179,1,.35);
  border-radius:10px; padding:.45rem .9rem;
  font-weight:600; font-size:.88rem;
  text-decoration:none; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  transition: all .2s ease;
}
.nav-cta:hover{ background: rgba(245,179,1,.28); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* -------- Layout -------- */
.page-wrap{max-width:1240px; margin:0 auto; padding: 22px 26px 40px;}
.section-title{
  font-size:1.65rem; font-weight:700; font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
  margin: 6px 0 18px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;
}
.section-title::before{
  content:''; display:inline-block; width:6px; height:28px; border-radius:4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), #ff8a00);
}
.section-sub{ color:var(--muted); font-size:.95rem; margin:-12px 0 22px; }

/* -------- Hero -------- */
.hero{
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  padding: 68px 44px 60px;
  border-radius: 26px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 400px at 15% 0%, rgba(99,102,241,.35), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(800px 400px at 90% 100%, rgba(6,182,212,.28), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1220 0%, #131c3a 60%, #0a1e2e 100%);
  color:#f8fafc;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -20px rgba(11,18,32,.55);
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.12);
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}
.hero::before{
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 22%, rgba(245,179,1,.35) 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 78% 60%, rgba(6,182,212,.35) 0 1px, transparent 2px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 55% 80%, rgba(255,255,255,.2) 0 1px, transparent 2px);
  background-size: 340px 340px, 420px 420px, 260px 260px;
  opacity:.55; pointer-events:none;
}
.hero::after{
  content:''; position:absolute; top:-40%; right:-10%; width:520px; height:520px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(245,179,1,.22), transparent 65%);
  filter: blur(30px);
  animation: floaty 14s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes floaty{
  0%,100%{ transform: translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1); }
  50%    { transform: translate3d(-30px,20px,0) scale(1.06); }
}

.hero-inner{ position:relative; z-index:2; max-width: 780px; }
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background: rgba(245,179,1,.14); color:#fbbf24;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,179,1,.3);
  padding:6px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  font-size:.74rem; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:700;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.eyebrow .dot{
  width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%;
  background:#fbbf24; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,179,1,.2);
  animation: pulse 2s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse{
  0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,179,1,.2); }
  50%    { box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(245,179,1,.05); }
}
.hero-name{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  line-height:1.02;
  margin:0 0 12px;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
}
.hero-name .accent{
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24 0%, #fb7185 55%, #a78bfa 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
}
.hero-role{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  font-size:1.05rem; color:#e2e8f0; font-weight:500;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding: 6px 16px 6px 12px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.2);
  border-radius:999px;
}
.hero-role .degree-tag{
  background: linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24,#f97316);
  color:#0b1220; font-weight:800;
  padding:2px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-size:.78rem;
  letter-spacing:.03em;
}
.hero-bio{
  font-size:1.02rem; line-height:1.65; color:#cbd5e1;
  max-width: 620px; margin: 6px 0 26px;
}
.hero-badges{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-bottom:26px; }
.hero-badges .chip{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  padding:8px 14px; border-radius:999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.22);
  color:#e2e8f0; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:500;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  transition: all .2s ease;
}
.hero-badges .chip:hover{
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.hero-badges .chip i{ color:#fbbf24; }
.hero-cta{ display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.btn-gold{
  background: linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24 0%, #f97316 100%) !important;
  color:#0b1220 !important; font-weight:700 !important;
  border:none !important; border-radius:12px !important;
  padding:12px 24px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(251,191,36,.35) !important;
  transition: transform .2s ease !important;
}
.btn-gold:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn-ghost{
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.06) !important;
  color:#f8fafc !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.3) !important;
  border-radius:12px !important;
  padding:12px 22px !important;
  font-weight:600 !important;
  text-decoration:none !important;
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  transition: all .2s ease;
}
.btn-ghost:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.14) !important; transform: translateY(-2px); }

/* -------- KPI strip -------- */
.kpi-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap:18px; margin-bottom: 30px;
}
@media (max-width: 900px){ .kpi-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);} }
.kpi{
  padding:22px 22px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.14);
  transition: all .25s ease;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
.kpi:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgba(79,70,229,.28); }
.kpi::before{
  content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4f46e5, #06b6d4);
}
.kpi.gold::before{ background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbbf24, #f97316); }
.kpi.emerald::before{ background: linear-gradient(180deg, #34d399, #059669); }
.kpi.rose::before{ background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fb7185, #e11d48); }
.kpi-label{
  font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px;
}
.kpi-value{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:800;
  font-size:2rem; line-height:1; color:var(--ink);
}
.kpi-sub{ font-size:.8rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px; }

/* -------- Project cards -------- */
.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap:20px;
}
.pcard{
  padding:22px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.12);
  transition: transform .28s ease, box-shadow .28s ease, border-color .28s ease;
  cursor:pointer;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
  min-height: 250px;
}
.pcard::after{
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:auto -30% -40% auto; width:180px; height:180px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(79,70,229,.08), transparent 70%);
  transition: transform .35s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.pcard:hover{
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -18px rgba(79,70,229,.35);
  border-color: rgba(79,70,229,.28);
}
.pcard:hover::after{ transform: scale(1.3); }
.pcard-head{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.pcard-icon{
  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:12px;
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color:#fff; font-size:1.05rem;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.35);
}
.pcard-cat{
  font-size:.68rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:800; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:999px;
  background: #f1f5f9; color:#475569;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.pcard-title{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700;
  font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 8px; color:var(--ink);
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
.pcard-summary{
  font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink-2); line-height:1.55;
  margin:0 0 16px; flex-grow:1;
}
.pcard-tags{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-bottom:14px; }
.pcard-tag{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.68rem; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px;
  background: #eef2ff; color:#4338ca;
  border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.18);
}
.pcard-footer{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:12px;
}
.pcard-footer .arrow{ transition: transform .28s ease; }
.pcard:hover .pcard-footer .arrow{ transform: translateX(4px); color:var(--brand); }

/* -------- Filter bar -------- */
.filter-bar{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; align-items:center;
  margin-bottom:24px; padding: 14px 18px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:16px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.filter-bar .form-control,
.filter-bar .form-select{
  border-radius:10px !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.35) !important;
  font-size:.9rem;
  padding:9px 14px;
  background:#fff;
}
.filter-bar .form-control:focus,
.filter-bar .form-select:focus{
  border-color: var(--brand) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(79,70,229,.12) !important;
}

/* -------- Skills -------- */
.skills-grid{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px,1fr));
  gap:20px;
}
.skill-card{
  padding:24px; border-radius:18px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -14px rgba(15,23,42,.14);
  transition: all .25s ease;
}
.skill-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(79,70,229,.3); }
.skill-card h4{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-size:1.15rem; margin:0 0 14px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
}
.skill-card h4 i{ color: var(--brand); }
.skill-row{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  margin: 10px 0; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink-2);
}
.skill-bar{
  height:8px; background:#e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;
  margin: 6px 0 14px;
}
.skill-bar span{
  display:block; height:100%; border-radius:6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4f46e5, #06b6d4);
}
.skill-bar.gold span{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fbbf24, #f97316); }
.skill-bar.emerald span{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, #34d399, #059669); }

/* -------- About -------- */
.about-card{
  padding:32px; border-radius:20px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -16px rgba(15,23,42,.18);
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.about-card p{ font-size:.96rem; line-height:1.75; color:var(--ink-2); }
.about-card h3{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; margin-top:0; color:var(--ink);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
}
.about-card h3 i{ color: var(--gold); }

/* -------- Modal -------- */
.modal-content{
  border-radius:22px !important; border:none !important;
  box-shadow: 0 40px 100px -20px rgba(11,18,32,.55) !important;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.modal-header{
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b1220 0%, #1e293b 100%);
  color:#f8fafc; border:none !important;
  padding: 24px 28px;
}
.modal-header .modal-title{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.35rem;
}
.modal-body{ padding: 26px 28px 30px; }
.modal-footer{ border-top:1px solid var(--line) !important; padding:16px 24px; }
.modal .cat-badge{
  font-size:.68rem; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:800; padding:5px 12px; border-radius:999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color:#f8fafc;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
.modal .tag{
  display:inline-block; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.72rem; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:8px;
  background:#eef2ff; color:#4338ca; margin: 2px 6px 2px 0;
  border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.18);
}

/* -------- Footer -------- */
.footer{
  text-align:center; padding: 34px 20px 6px;
  color: var(--muted); font-size:.86rem;
}
.footer .heart{ color:#e11d48; }
.footer .brand-mark{
  font-family:'Fraunces',serif; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink);
}

.mb-20{ margin-bottom:20px; }
.mt-24{ margin-top:24px; }

::-webkit-scrollbar{ width:10px; height:10px; }

# ============================================================
#  UI HELPERS
# ============================================================
make_card <- function(p){
  accent <- cat_colors[[p$category]]
  tags_list <- strsplit(p$tools, ",")[[1]]
  tools_tags <- lapply(tags_list, function(t) span(class="pcard-tag", trimws(t)))

  div(class = "pcard",
      onclick = sprintf(
        "Shiny.setInputValue('card_clicked', %d, {priority:'event'});", p$id),
      div(class="pcard-head",
          div(class="pcard-icon",
              style=sprintf("background: linear-gradient(135deg, %s, %s);",
                            accent, accent),
              icon(p$icon)),
          span(class="pcard-cat", p$category)
      ),
      h3(class="pcard-title", p$title),
      p(class="pcard-summary", p$summary),
      div(class="pcard-tags", tools_tags),
      div(class="pcard-footer",
          span("View project"),
          span(class="arrow", icon("arrow-right"))
      )
  )
}

make_kpi <- function(label, value, sub, variant = ""){
  div(class = paste("kpi", variant),
      div(class="kpi-label", label),
      div(class="kpi-value", value),
      div(class="kpi-sub", sub)
  )
}

# ============================================================
#  SERVER
# ============================================================
server <- function(input, output, session){

  # -------- Safe null-coalesce helper (must be defined first) --------
  `%||%` <- function(a, b){
    if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a
  }

  # -------- Navigation from Home tab --------
  observeEvent(input$go_portfolio, {
    bslib::nav_select(id = "navbar", selected = "Portfolio")
  })
  observeEvent(input$go_portfolio2, {
    bslib::nav_select(id = "navbar", selected = "Portfolio")
  })
  observeEvent(input$go_about, {
    bslib::nav_select(id = "navbar", selected = "About")
  })

  # -------- Reactive filter --------
  filtered <- reactive({
    df <- projects

    if (!is.null(input$cat_filter) && input$cat_filter != "All categories") {
      df <- df[df$category == input$cat_filter, , drop = FALSE]
    }

    q <- trimws(tolower(input$search %||% ""))
    if (nzchar(q)) {
      haystack <- tolower(paste(df$title, df$summary, df$tools, df$category))
      df <- df[str_detect(haystack, fixed(q)), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    df
  })

  output$result_count <- renderText({
    n <- nrow(filtered())
    sprintf("%d project%s", n, if (n == 1) "" else "s")
  })

  output$project_grid <- renderUI({
    df <- filtered()
    if (nrow(df) == 0){
      return(div(style = "padding:60px 20px; text-align:center; color:#64748b;",
                 icon("magnifying-glass",
                      style="font-size:2.2rem; margin-bottom:14px;"),
                 h3(style="font-family:'Fraunces',serif;",
                    "No projects match your filters."),
                 p("Try clearing the search box or choosing a different category.")))
    }
    div(class = "grid",
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) make_card(df[i, ])))
  })

  # -------- Card modal --------
  observeEvent(input$card_clicked, {
    req(input$card_clicked)
    p <- projects[projects$id == input$card_clicked, , drop = FALSE]
    req(nrow(p) == 1)
    accent <- cat_colors[[p$category]]
    tags_list <- trimws(strsplit(p$tools, ",")[[1]])

    showModal(modalDialog(
      easyClose = TRUE,
      size = "l",
      title = tagList(
        span(class = "cat-badge", p$category),
        span(style = "margin-left:14px;", p$title)
      ),
      div(
        div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:20px;",
            div(style = sprintf(
                  "width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:14px;
                   background: linear-gradient(135deg, %s, %s);
                   display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
                   color:#fff; font-size:1.4rem;
                   box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px %s;",
                  accent, accent, accent),
                icon(p$icon)
            ),
            div(
              h3(style = "margin:0; font-family:'Fraunces',serif;", p$title),
              div(style = "color:#64748b; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600;",
                  p$category, " · Project ", p$id, " of 24")
            )
        ),

        h4(style = "font-family:'Fraunces',serif; margin: 12px 0 8px;",
           "Overview"),
        p(style = "font-size:1rem; line-height:1.7; color:#1e293b;", p$summary),

        h4(style = "font-family:'Fraunces',serif; margin: 22px 0 10px;",
           "Tools & Techniques"),
        div(style = "display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;",
            lapply(tags_list, function(t) span(class = "tag", t))
        ),

        div(style = "margin-top:26px; padding:16px 20px;
                    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eef2ff,#ecfeff);
                    border-radius:14px;
                    border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.18);
                    font-size:.9rem; color:#3730a3;",
            icon("circle-info"),
            " This project is documented as a fully reproducible R Markdown
              notebook with code, outputs, tables and visualisations."
        )
      ),
      footer = tagList(
        modalButton("Close"),
        tags$button(class = "btn btn-primary",
                    style = "background: linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#06b6d4);
                             border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:9px 20px;
                             font-weight:600;",
                    icon("download"), " Request Source")
      )
    ))
  })
}

# ============================================================
#  RUN
# ============================================================
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
